Mechanistic interpretation

Curated mechanism: Promoter-swap/expression-driven fusion, not domain-retention: neither TMPRSS2 nor ERG is oncogenic alone. TMPRSS2's androgen-responsive promoter drives ERG overexpression; there is no catalytic/kinase domain whose retention determines oncogenicity here, unlike the domain-retention mechanism BRAF/RET/ALK/NTRK1 (and EML4-ALK) fusions rely on.
